summary: Full frontend testing of /yatirim-fonu page (İPAT Arazi Fonu landing page). All 12 test scenarios executed and passed. Page loads correctly, all sections render, both API forms (basvuru + bekleme-listesi) POST successfully with success messages shown.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF Sunum dosyası is MOCKED (mock placeholder, no real file URL). This is by design per review request.
Sunum Görüntüle and PDF İndir buttons in Sunum Dosyası section are present but have no real PDF link (mock). Should be connected to a real PDF URL when ready.

test_credentials.note: No auth required for /yatirim-fonu public page

seed_data_creation: Created test investor basvuru (test@example.com) and bekleme listesi entry (test@bekleme.com) via form submissions during testing.
